title_sq: Tek Fillimi i Ish Tregut Elektrik, Shitet Super Apartament 1+1!!!

title_en: At the beginning of the former Electric Market, Super Apartment 1+1 for sale!!!
description_en: At the former Electric Market, near Municipal Unit no. 2 spacious 1+1 apartment for sale. The apartment is located on the 4th floor and has a net mortgaged area of ​​65m². It is organized in a spacious corridor, living room with kitchenette, bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet. It is oriented to the South-East, enabling abundant natural lighting. It looks free. The area where it is located is quite preferred both for residence and for investment, since the rent values ​​in this area are high. It has every possible facility such as nurseries, kindergartens, schools and any other service. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
